description: Template Family configuration for DeepLearning-Copilot Standard Set.

presentation_families.description: 结构化字段块。使用稳定字段标签逐行呈现实验信息，但不使用 JSON 作为用户输入格式。
presentation_families.render_contract: Render all required observations as labeled key-value lines under a compact experiment snapshot.

presentation_families.description: 表格报告。将必要实验指标组织成两列或多列表格。
presentation_families.render_contract: Render required observations in a compact table-like report with explicit field names and values.

presentation_families.description: 实验跟踪器导出格式。模拟 experiment tracker 中的 run summary 和 key=value 字段。
presentation_families.render_contract: Render observations as an experiment-tracker style run export using explicit key=value fields.

presentation_families.description: 简洁实验记录。将必要指标写成短篇自然语言记录。
presentation_families.render_contract: Render every required observation inside a concise natural-language experiment note.

presentation_families.description: 调试工单格式。使用 Context、Observations、Question 等结构描述实验问题。
presentation_families.render_contract: Render the sample as a debugging ticket with explicit Context, Observations, and Question sections.

presentation_families.description: 自然语言实验总结。将指标嵌入连续的实验运行描述中。
presentation_families.render_contract: Render all required observations inside a continuous narrative run summary without a key-value layout.
